subject: Fonctionnement d'une voiture électrique

fact_sheet.components: battery, inverter, electric motor, transmission, wheels
fact_sheet.functions: battery stores energy, inverter converts DC to AC and controls power, motor converts electrical energy to mechanical, transmission transfers mechanical energy, wheels enable car motion
fact_sheet.energy_direction: from battery to wheels while driving; from wheels to battery during regenerative braking
fact_sheet.transformations: chemical to electrical in battery, electrical to mechanical in motor, mechanical to kinetic in wheels
fact_sheet.common_errors: oversimplifying the inverter's role, depicting the motor as a simple black box
causal_chain: battery chemical energy -> electrical energy in the circuit
power electronics / inverter converts DC to AC and controls the power
vehicle kinetic energy -> motor acting as a generator
electrical energy -> power electronics -> battery charging

script: Voyez comment une voiture électrique fonctionne: l'électricité passe de la batterie au moteur. Celle-ci active le moteur qui fait tourner les roues. En freinage, l'énergie est renvoyée vers la batterie.

visual_bible.colors: yellow/orange for electricity, blue for battery, grey for mechanics, green for regenerative energy
visual_bible.invisible_phenomena: yellow/orange energy flows, green return flows

shots.voice: Voyez comment une voiture électrique fonctionne: l'électricité passe de la batterie au moteur.
shots.visual_description: The electric car's battery shows visible cells. Yellow/orange energy streams flow from the battery into the high-voltage cables.

shots.visual_description: The electric motor shows the yellow/orange energy entering. The rotor inside the motor starts rotating as energy enters.

shots.visual_concept: Energy flow into the motor and rotor rotation

shots.visual_description: The vehicle's wheels visibly decelerate, and green energy flows back toward the motor and then to the battery.
